$description: Screen and element spec for fwapp (Fishlog), extracted from the shipped Jinja2 templates in app/web/templates/. Children are listed IN PAINT ORDER, top to bottom. Token names refer to docs/figma/tokens.json. This describes what exists, not what somebody wishes existed - if a screen here disagrees with the template, the template wins.

meta.note: The app brands itself 'Fishlog' in the topbar. The repository and the owner call it 'fwapp'. Both names are in use; this is unresolved, not a mistake to fix silently.

phone.description: THE design target. Draw every screen here first.

desktop.description: The adaptation, not the target. Content column is max-width 960px, centred.

rules: One primary action per screen, in the bottom third (thumb zone), minimum 48x48.
Destructive actions out of the thumb arc - top of screen or behind a confirm.
Never draw a numeric score, a percentage, a rating out of ten, or a progress arc for fishing quality. Day quality is a COLOUR BAND ONLY.
Any number that comes from data carries its sample size n beside it.
Light ground only. There is no dark mode and one is not wanted.
No sharp corners. radius 20 for cards, 13 for buttons, 999 for pills.
Do not draw a fake iOS status bar or a fake keyboard.
Blank sessions are first-class: a session with zero catches must be as easy to end as a good one, and must never look like an error.

children.name: topnav
children.note: Hidden on phone; the bottomnav carries it instead.

children.name: lang-switch
children.note: Active option gets surface fill + shadow.e1 + accent-deep text.

waterline.description: A 2px line under the topbar. It ripples outward from wherever you tap and swells while a request is in flight. Decorative, aria-hidden. Draw it as a plain 2px rule; the behaviour is CSS.

ambient.description: Six fish crossing the page on 22-37s cycles, staggered 1-26s. pointer-events none, aria-hidden. In a static Figma frame draw AT MOST ONE fish, small, at ~50% opacity, well clear of any text or control. Do not draw six at once - that is not what the screen ever looks like.

bream.tail: long fork, lower lobe dropped well past the upper

crucian.tail: rounded convex fan, NO fork at all

rudd.body: deeper than roach, snout turned up

carp.tail: broad SHALLOW fork - half the notch depth, twice the width
carp.body: thick, long low dorsal ridge, no barbels

ambient.speciesRule: Every species owns its geometry. The TAIL ALONE must identify the fish with the body hidden. The dorsal fin is part of the body outline, never a separate arc floating above it. No polygon fins, no triangles standing in for a tail. Two species sharing a tail wedge means the set has failed.

session-fab.visibleWhen: a session is running and you are not already on the session screen
session-fab.content: a float icon (elongated teardrop body, thin antenna with a coloured tip, thin stem below, small eye ring). NOT a circle on a stick.
session-fab.motion: the float rides, knocks twice, buries, and rides back up - a bite. 4.2s loop.

page.note: 96px bottom padding clears the bottomnav and the session float.

children.name: water-hero
children.note: A photographic water band, warm-toned to match the kraft ground. 20KB desktop / 4.1KB phone.

children.name: switch
children.note: One track, one sliding thumb, exactly one option active. Thumb is surface + shadow.e1.

children.name: place-thumb
children.note: A traced outline of the real lake, or a river line, or a rounded rectangle for a commercial pond. Never the accent - amber reads as land.

children.name: badge

variants.neutral: ground.surface-sunk bg / ink.ink-soft text, 1px line inset

children.note: This badge is the day band for that water. It is a colour and a word, never a number.

children.name: empty-state
children.note: Never a crossed-out icon or an error tone. An empty list is not a fault.

children.name: removed-places
children.note: Soft-removed waters live here with a Restore button. Nothing is ever deleted.

primaryAction.label: pick a spot on the map
primaryAction.note: The map itself is the action - tap it, or drag the fish pin onto it.

children.name: session-banner
children.note: This page deliberately does NOT redirect to the running session. Conditions and the map are exactly what an angler wants mid-session.

children.name: day-strip
children.note: Behind the calendar icon. Selecting a day re-scores the map. A day with no stored prediction shows as 'no data' and gets NO colour - it never borrows its neighbour's.

children.name: now-ring

stroke.color: the day's band MARK, or ground.line-strong when unknown

children.note: THE SIGNATURE ELEMENT. A FULL ring, never a partial arc - an arc that fills further on a better day is a progress bar, and a progress bar is a score out of ten wearing a hat. The interior is always canvas-deep; the day's colour lives in the stroke and nowhere else. Under a forecast day the stroke goes dashed and neutral.

children.name: registered-catch
children.note: The only MEASURED number on this page, and its n travels with it. kg per angler-day from the district register - never averaged with the notebook's own fish-per-hour.

children.name: weather-table
children.note: Tapping a row also re-scores the map.

children.name: fish-pin
children.note: Drag onto the map to choose a swim. It DIVES NOSE FIRST - this shipped tail-first three times. Splash at 705ms, spot chosen at 900ms.

children.name: pin-hint
children.text: Drag the fish onto the map - or just tap the water - to pick your spot.

children.name: map-wrap
children: map-day-badge when a forecast day is selected

children.name: heat-legend
children.note: A gradient with two words. No numbers.

children.name: provenance-note
children.note: States plainly that the zone overlay is provisional and unvalidated.

children.name: intel-card
children.note: Local knowledge, translated into all three languages.

children.name: already-running
children.visibleWhen: a session is already running elsewhere
children.note: This is an EXPECTED state, not an error. Do not draw it in the danger tone.

children.name: counter
children.note: A raw catch count for THIS session's morale only. Fish-per-hour lives on History. Do not relabel this as CPUE.

children.name: inline-link-row
children.note: Conditions and the map must stay reachable during a running session. Do not remove these.

item.name: fish-btn
item.note: One tap logs a fish. Six favourite species.

children.name: weight-slider
children.note: Bounds reset per species; the readout is tabular.

item.name: catch-card
item.note: Delete is the ONLY hard delete in this app and it asks first.

children.name: summary
children.note: If zero catches, this says the session will be saved as a BLANK and that blanks count fully in every statistic. It is not an error state and must not look like one.

children.name: history-table
children.note: A blank session shows the word 'blank' in the fish column, never a bare 0, and is counted in every total.

item.name: candidate-card
item.note: PZW districts are offered first, named and bounded by the register. Ambiguous water type gets two buttons rather than a guess.

children.name: btn-google
children.note: Only rendered when Google sign-in is configured. A button that would fail is never drawn.

children.name: fields
children.note: Inline validation appears under a field on blur: the label gets the error tone and a one-line message in semantic.warn-ink.

screens.title: Marketing page
screens.note: A DIFFERENT register from the app screens - richer, scroll-driven, read once on wifi. It is not part of the five-screen flow and must not be designed to match the in-app density. Do not link it from '/' for a signed-in angler.

flow.$description: The order is fixed and is not a suggestion. Do not design a one-tap start.

primary.trigger: tap the map, or drag the fish pin onto it

sideways.note: Required. Standing rule: conditions and map stay reachable mid-session.
